messages:
marie: Quick heads-up — webinar on Tue 2026-04-28 10:00 PT. Need X + LinkedIn plan that leads with our latency/cost benchmark narrative. Who can own copy + images? Also need routing instructions for inbound signups. :raising_hand:
aj: I can draft X thread. Will highlight 3 data points (p95 latency, cost/token, quantized model size). Need final numbers + 2 quotes from eng.
sam: I'll do LinkedIn post + carousel images. Can someone share the final slides/export assets? preferred images 1200x628 and 1080x1080.
devon: I have the slides — exporting now. Will upload to the marketing drive in ~30m: https://drive.redwood/example
olivia: For engagement: we'll do 1st-hour live reply squad: aj + me + tori. SDRs should get a lead tag `webinar-x1` to route to BDR queue. Anyone confirm HubSpot mapping?
aj: HubSpot property is `lead_source` -> value `webinar_x_apr28`. I'll add workflow to create task for BDRs if `attended=true`.
marie: Perfect. Also want a short benchmark thread outline: 1) lead: headline claim, 2) quick stat, 3) visual, 4) link to blog, 5) CTA to watch webinar. Keep it tight.
sam: Draft LinkedIn post:
```
We're shipping LLM features with 2.4x lower latency and 35% less per-token cost — and we explain how in our upcoming webinar. Join us Tue 10AM PT. Register: https://redwood.ai/webinar
```
aj: X thread draft (will shorten): 1/ Claim 2/ Stat 3/ How we measured 4/ Real numbers + graph image 5/ CTA + signup link
marie: Need shortened link with UTM: add `?utm_source=social&utm_campaign=webinar_apr28&utm_medium=x` and same for LinkedIn with `utm_medium=linkedin`
social-bot: Proposed schedule (local times):
```
- Tue 09:55 PT: X teaser (1 tweet) + LI teaser
- Tue 09:58 PT: X thread start (tweet 1/5)
- Tue 10:00 PT: webinar live tweet + LI live update
- Tue 10:30 PT: follow-up tweet w/ clip + slide image
```
aj: I'll split thread into 5 tweets. Need approval by Mon EOD.
devon: Uploaded assets here: https://drive.redwood/example/slides_export.zip. Images are 1200x628 and 1080x1080.
olivia: SDR routing note: add tag `source:webinar_apr28` and set owner to `BDR_APAC` for APAC attendees. Also enable `notify_channel` to #sales-inbound for hot leads :mailbox_with_mail:
sam: Also request: can eng give a 1-sentence quote from lead infra about tradeoffs? we have time to add as pull quote.
marie: @aj @sam confirm you'll have copy + images by Mon 5pm PT? If yes I'll schedule promo ads.
aj: yes, on it. :thumbsup:
sam: yes — will upload final LI copy + images by Mon 4:30pm PT.
marie: Great. I'll follow up Monday to approve. Thanks everyone.
